hints: Replacing $x$ with $3x$ is a horizontal stretch of scale factor $1/3$.
Adding $2$ to the function is a vertical translation by $\binom{0}{2}$.
walkthrough:
Identify the horizontal transformation from $x \to 3x$:
$$\text{Stretch with scale factor } \frac{1}{3} \text{ parallel to the } x\text{-axis (in the } x\text{-direction)}$$

Identify the vertical transformation from $+2$:
$$\text{Translation by vector } \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix} \text{ (or } 2 \text{ units in the positive } y\text{-direction)}$$

hints: Stretch in $y$-direction multiplies the entire function by $3$.
walkthrough:
Apply a stretch by scale factor $3$ in the $y$-direction to $y = g(x)$:
$$y = 3g(x)$$

Apply a reflection in the $y$-axis by replacing $x$ with $-x$:
$$y = 3g(-x)$$
